# Lanesra OS — Detailed Product Context

Lanesra OS is an independent, open-source business application designed for small businesses that need more structure than spreadsheets but less complexity than enterprise CRM and ERP platforms.

## Product status

The product is currently in Early Access v0.18.0. The public browser demo is usable and includes realistic sample data, including a fully working Admin panel - now with a Status Transition Editor (per-object allowed status/stage moves, wildcard "from any status" and an active toggle), workflow automation actions to create a new record or update a related record on top of creating a task, a Test rule / Test workflow dry-run mode, a rule-builder layout redesigned to match the desktop edition (numbered condition/effect sections, a live summary panel, and a visual trigger → action canvas for workflows), custom field extensibility (default value, uniqueness, placeholder and help text), and Customer 360 / Contact 360 detail pages linking every company and contact to its related records. The Windows desktop application is in early development: the source is public today (Tauri v2 + Rust + SQLite), with the full sales lifecycle already working end to end - Companies, Contacts, Products, Opportunities, Quotes, Orders and Invoices, including quote-to-order and order-to-invoice conversion, atomic document numbering and local user authentication. Also working: Contracts, Tasks, user management, Team Workspace mode for small teams (Docker), whole-workspace backup and restore, self-service password change, PDF generation and printing, and CSV import/export. On top of that fixed schema, an Admin panel now ships: user & role management (moved out of the main navigation into its own section), an editable business profile (name, phone, address, city, logo) used across the workspace and on print letterheads, reports beyond the dashboard plus a simple custom report builder (pick an object, group by any field including custom fields, count or sum), custom fields on every major object - Companies, Contacts, Opportunities, Quotes, Orders, Invoices, Contracts, Products and Tasks - not just Companies and Contacts, now with optional validation (min/max for numbers, max length and a regex pattern for text) and searchable/filterable/reportable capability flags. Admin-defined Custom Objects let an Administrator create an entirely new record type - its own fields, numbering and navigation section - with no code changes, and that new object automatically works with custom fields, business rules and the report builder. Custom relationships connect any two record types (built-in or custom) with a choice of cardinality (one-to-one, many-to-one, many-to-many) and what happens to linked records on delete, surfaced as a related-records list on record detail pages. The business rules engine now supports multiple AND/OR conditions, 10 comparison operators, and lock/set-default/set-value/block-save/show-message actions, not just require/hide. Workflow automation now triggers on field changes and dates reached/overdue in addition to status changes, and can assign the record's owner, create a related record, or post an in-app notification (shown in a new notification bell) in addition to creating a task. Also shipped: Windows task reminder notifications (native toast notifications through the desktop app's webview) and a session inactivity auto-lock. There is no signed installer yet; it is built and run from source, or from an unsigned Early Access Windows installer on GitHub Releases.

## Product history

- May 2026: Product idea and vision defined.
- June 2026: Architecture, scope and offline strategy established.
- July 2026: Design system and web MVP built.
- August 2026: Public Early Access launched.
- August 2026: Windows desktop edition foundation published (Tauri + SQLite, full sales lifecycle).
- August 2026: Contracts, Tasks and user management added on desktop.
- August 2026: Team Workspace mode, backup/restore, and self-service password change shipped.
- August 2026: PDF generation/printing and CSV import/export shipped.
- August 2026: An admin-configurable layer shipped on top of the fixed schema - branding and print customization, reports beyond the dashboard, custom fields on Companies and Contacts, conditional business rules over those fields, and Phase 1 workflow automation (auto-created follow-up tasks on Opportunity/Invoice status changes).
- August 2026: An Admin panel shipped generalizing that layer across nearly every object - user & role management, editable business profile with phone, custom fields/business rules/workflow automation on Companies, Contacts, Opportunities, Quotes, Orders, Invoices, Contracts, Products and Tasks, admin-configurable numbering formats, a simple custom report builder and a dashboard KPI picker. The online demo was updated to mirror the same Admin panel in the browser.
- August 2026: Admin-defined Custom Objects shipped - a new record type an Administrator defines with no code, working automatically with custom fields, business rules and the report builder.
- August 2026: Custom relationships between any two record types, a richer business rules engine (multi-condition, 10 operators, more actions), richer workflow automation (more triggers/actions, in-app notifications), custom field validation and capability flags, Windows task reminder notifications, and a session inactivity auto-lock all shipped.
- August 2026: The online demo caught up with a Status Transition Editor, workflow actions to create a new record or update a related record, a Test rule / Test workflow dry-run mode, a rule-builder layout redesigned to match the desktop edition (numbered sections, a live summary panel, a visual workflow canvas), custom field extensibility (default value, uniqueness, placeholder, help text), and Customer 360 / Contact 360 detail pages.
- Next milestone: a code-signed installer, and global search/list-view filtering.

## Core workflows

Customer records connect to contacts, opportunities, quotes, orders, invoices, contracts and tasks. Opportunities are optional for quotes. Quotes are optional for orders. Orders are optional for invoices. Relationship dropdowns are filtered by customer to preserve data integrity. Quotes, orders and invoices include product or service line items with quantities and pricing.

## Product principles

- Open source and transparent
- No licence activation
- Simple by default
- Modern user experience
- Local data ownership, now working in the early-access desktop edition
- Public roadmap and changelog
